entries.summary: On Windows the device credential store calls Credential Manager through koffi in the daemon process (#1445). Entry names and bytes do not change, so a rollback still reads them. Breaking for a CJS or SEA Windows Host: readDeviceEnrollmentStatus, readDeviceEnrollmentIdentity and createStoredDeviceProofSigner run outside the daemon, so pass them the new nativeAssetRoot option with the same value as DaemonConfig.nativeAssetRoot; without it they fail with DeviceCredentialStoreUnavailableError because koffi cannot load. A packaged Windows Host daemon without DaemonConfig.nativeAssetRoot cannot pair or authenticate; this includes a bun --compile Host, not only CJS and SEA cold reads. An npm install needs no change. @byok-sdk/client/packaging now exports loadSdkKoffiAsset for a packaged Host to give its validated koffi to @byok-sdk/keys.
